title: Wendell and the Bakery
author: Ines Brightwater
blurb: Orsen Lockridge, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
